participation.context: Read the three words, wiped nothing, and opened a fresh sheet.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You looked at the leaf and did not rub it out. The question mark stayed ink. You went to the sheet.

title: Read cloves, Yaxley, and the lark, and turned the leaf

description: She lies, and then he does

participation.context: Wrote her opening and his answer, and marked that he stays.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Stayed on the far corner of the board, off the paper.
participation.name: Gib

story.body: You let her say it was the nightingale and not the lark. He answered that the day had come, and you kept him because she asked. The sheet was only begun.

title: Let her call it the nightingale

participation.context: Wrote on, and did not clear the saucer.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You kept writing. The saucer stayed by the inkhorn. You did not move it for the light.

title: Saw the clove-wool by the inkhorn

description: The woes, and the nurse at the door

participation.context: Finished the stretch at the nurse's door and did not make a fair copy.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote down to the woes and set the nurse at the door. You left the page foul.

title: Wrote eighty lines, down to the nurse at the door

participation.context: Copied the three leaves, folded them, and laid them under the account book.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You made the fair copy nobody had asked for. You folded it once. You put it under the account book.

title: Copied the three leaves and put them away

participation.context: Spoke the fact of the three leaves, and refused the reason.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said where the leaves are. You did not give a reason. You let the candle go.

title: Said where the leaves are, and stopped
